body.x: GJSROBOTS participated in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its robot with motion recognition controller.

Founded in 2015, GJSROBOT launched GANKERand GELO, followed by its 3rd-gen robots GANKER EX. Since it has a motionrecognition controller, robots move along when the user wears the controllerand move. When you battle, the robot is equipped with a sensor that recognizesthe attack and automatically calculates the score to determine the outcome.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows thetrend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted byConsumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS hasreported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major techexhibitions for the past 13 years.
